```java
    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {
        int left1   = rec1[0];
        int bottom1 = rec1[1];
        int right1  = rec1[2];
        int top1    = rec1[3];

        int left2   = rec2[0];
        int bottom2 = rec2[1];
        int right2  = rec2[2];
        int top2    = rec2[3];

        return !(bottom2 >= top1 ||
                 top2 <= bottom1 ||
                 left2 >= right1 ||
                 right2 <= left1);
```
```java
    }
}
```

```java
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
```

```java
public class IsPalindrome {
    public static boolean isPalindrome(String s) {
        int n = s.length();

        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            if (s.charAt(i) != s.charAt(n - 1 - i)) {
```
```java
                return false;
            }
```
```java
        }

        return true;
```
```java
    }
}
```

public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
```java
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
```

```java
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
```
```java
        }

        return true;
```
```java
    }
}
```

```java
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {
                biggest = index;
            }
            index = index + 1;
        }
        return biggest;
```
```java
    }
}
```

```java
public class MatrixSum {
    public static int[][] matrixSum(int[][] a, int[][] b) {
        int n = a.length;
        int m = a[0].length;

        int[][] c = new int[n][m];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                c[i][j] = a[i][j] + b[i][j];
            }
        }

        return c;
```
```java
    }
}
```

```java
    //@ requires (operator != '/' && operator != '%') || num2 != 0;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures (operator == '+') ==> (\result == (long)num1 + num2);

            output = (long)num1 / num2;
            break;
```

```java
public class IsRectangleOverlap {
    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {
        int left1   = rec1[0];
        int bottom1 = rec1[1];
        int right1  = rec1[2];
        int top1    = rec1[3];

        int left2   = rec2[0];
        int bottom2 = rec2[1];
        int right2  = rec2[2];
        int top2    = rec2[3];

        return !(bottom2 >= top1 ||
                 top2 <= bottom1 ||
                 left2 >= right1 ||
                 right2 <= left1);
    }
}
```

```java
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsUndirectedGraph {
    public static boolean isUndirectedGraph(int[][] adjacencyMat) {
        int nVert = adjacencyMat.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < nVert; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < nVert; j++) {
                if (adjacencyMat[i][j] != adjacencyMat[j][i]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsUndirectedGraph {
    //@ requires adjacencyMat != null;
    //@ requires (\forall int i; 0 <= i < adjacencyMat.length; adjacencyMat[i] != null && adjacencyMat[i].length == adjacencyMat.length);
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i < adjacencyMat.length && i < j < adjacencyMat.length; adjacencyMat[i][j] == adjacencyMat[j][i]);
    public static boolean isUndirectedGraph(int[][] adjacencyMat) {
        int nVert = adjacencyMat.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= nVert;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int x, y; 0 <= x < i && x < y < nVert; adjacencyMat[x][y] == adjacencyMat[y][x]);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases nVert - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < nVert; i++) {
            //@ maintaining i < nVert;
            //@ maintaining i + 1 <= j <= nVert;
            //@ maintaining (\forall int k; i + 1 <= k < j; adjacencyMat[i][k] == adjacencyMat[k][i]);
            //@ loop_writes j;
            //@ decreases nVert - j;
            for (int j = i + 1; j < nVert; j++) {
                if (adjacencyMat[i][j] != adjacencyMat[j][i]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
```

```java
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```java
    //@ ensures (\exists int i, j; 0 <= i < j < nums.length; nums[i] + nums[j] == target) ==>
```

```java
    //@           nums[\result[0]] + nums[\result[1]] == target);

    //@          \result.length == 0;
    public static int[] twoSum(int[] nums, int target) {
        int n = nums.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
```
        //@ maintaining \forall int a, b; 0 < a < b < i; nums[a] + nums[b] != target;  
        //@ loop_invariant 0 <= i && i <= n;
        //@ loop_modifies i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            //@ maintaining i + 1 <= j && j <= n;
            //@ maintaining \forall int a; i < a < j; nums[i] + nums[a] != target;
            //@ loop_invariant i + 1 <= j && j <= n;

```java
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
```

```java
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
    //@        (digits[i] == 1 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 1) ||
    //@        (digits[i] == 8 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 8) ||
    //@        (digits[i] == 6 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 9) ||
    //@        (digits[i] == 9 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 6))
    //@     ) &&
    //@     (digits.length % 2 == 0 || 
    //@      digits[digits.length / 2] == 0 || digits[digits.length / 2] == 1 || digits[digits.length / 2] == 8)
    //@   )
    //@ );
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= len / 2;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i;
        //@   ((digits[j] == 0 && digits[len - j - 1] == 0) ||
        //@    (digits[j] == 1 && digits[len - j - 1] == 1) ||
        //@    (digits[j] == 8 && digits[len - j - 1] == 8) ||
        //@    (digits[j] == 6 && digits[len - j - 1] == 9) ||
        //@    (digits[j] == 9 && digits[len - j - 1] == 6))
        //@ );
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases len / 2 - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IdxMaximum {
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {
                biggest = index;
            }
            index = index + 1;
        }
        return biggest;
    }
}
```

```java
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```java
    //@  requires arr == null || \forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; arr[i] != elem;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == -1;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    //@ pure
    public static int find(int[] arr, int elem) {
        if (arr == null)
            return -1;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= arr.length;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; arr[j] != elem;
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases arr.length - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++)
            if (arr[i] == elem)
                return i;
        return -1;
    }
}
```

Note: The added `//@ requires sum > Integer.MIN_VALUE;` inside the else branch loop is intended to ensure no underflow occurs when subtracting 1 from sum. To help the verifier, you can strengthen the loop invariant as follows:

```java

```

```java
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == x + y;
    public static int add(int x, int y) {
        int sum = x;
        if (y > 0) {
            int n = y;
```

```java
public class IsRectangleOverlap {
    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {
        int left1   = rec1[0];
        int bottom1 = rec1[1];
        int right1  = rec1[2];
        int top1    = rec1[3];

        int top2    = rec2[3];

                 top2 <= bottom1 ||
                 left2 >= right1 ||
                 right2 <= left1);
    }
}
```

```java
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

assistant: ```java
public class ArrayConcat {
    //@  requires a != null && b != null && (long) a.length + b.length <= Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result != null;
    //@  ensures \result.length == a.length + b.length;
    //@  ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i < a.length; \result[i] == a[i]);
    //@  ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i < b.length; \result[i + a.length] == b[i]);
    //@ also
    //@  requires a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == null;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= m;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i; ret[j] == a[j]);
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; i <= k < m; ret[k] == 0);
        //@ loop_writes ret[*], i;
        //@ decreases m - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
```

```java
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;
```

    //@ requires (\forall int i; 0 <= i < mat.length; mat[i] != null);
    //@ requires (\forall int i; 0 <= i < mat.length - 1; mat[i].length == mat[i+1].length);
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (
    //@   mat.length == 0 || 
    //@   (\forall int i, j; 1 <= i < mat.length && 1 <= j < mat[0].length; mat[i][j] == mat[i-1][j-1])
    //@ );
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        //@ maintaining 1 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining \forall int x, y; 1 <= x < i && 1 <= y < m; mat[x][y] == mat[x-1][y-1];
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            //@ maintaining 1 - 1 <= j <= m;  
            //@ maintaining \forall int y; 1 <= y < j; mat[i][y] == mat[i-1][y-1];
            //@ loop_writes j;
            //@ decreases m - j;
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

```java
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
```
```java
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));
    //@ also
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```java
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
```

```java
    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {
        int left1   = rec1[0];
        int bottom1 = rec1[1];
        int right1  = rec1[2];

        int top2    = rec2[3];

        return !(bottom2 >= top1 ||
                 top2 <= bottom1 ||
                 left2 >= right1 ||
                 right2 <= left1);
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class ReverseArray {
    public static int[] reverse(int[] original) {
        int n = original.length;
        int[] res = new int[n];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            res[i] = original[n - i - 1];
        }
        return res;
    }
}
```

```java
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```java
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```java
public class Swap1 {
    public static void swap(int[] arr, int a, int b) {
        if (arr == null || a >= arr.length || a < 0 || b >= arr.length ||
            b < 0) {
            return;
        }
        int temp = arr[a];
        arr[a] = arr[b];
        arr[b] = temp;
    }
}
```

```java
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures arr == \old(arr);
    //@ also
    //@ requires arr != null && 0 <= a && a < arr.length && 0 <= b && b < arr.length;
    //@ assigns arr[a], arr[b];
    //@ ensures arr[a] == \old(arr[b]) && arr[b] == \old(arr[a]);
    //@ ensures \forall int i; i != a && i != b && 0 <= i && i < arr.length; arr[i] == \old(arr[i]);
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static void swap(int[] arr, int a, int b) {
        if (arr == null || a >= arr.length || a < 0 || b >= arr.length ||
            b < 0) {
            return;
        }
        int temp = arr[a];
        arr[a] = arr[b];
        arr[b] = temp;
    }
```

```java
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```java
    //@ ensures (A != null && A.length > 0 && A[0] != null && A[0].length > 0 &&

    //@                   (\forall int j; 0 <= j < A[0].length; \result[i][j] == A[A.length - 1 - i][A[0].length - 1 - j])));
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;

        int m = A.length;
```

```java
public class ScalarProductSaturated {
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {
                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
}
```

```java
    //@ assigns \nothing;

    //@          (\forall int i; 0 <= i < vec.length;
    //@              (\let long prod = (long)vec[i] * (long)a;
    //@                  (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE ==> \result[i] == Integer.MAX_VALUE) &&
    //@                  (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE ==> \result[i] == Integer.MIN_VALUE) &&
    //@                  (prod >= Integer.MIN_VALUE && prod <= Integer.MAX_VALUE ==> \result[i] == (int)prod)
    //@              )

        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= vec.length;

        //@       (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE ==> ret[j] == Integer.MAX_VALUE) &&
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```java
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];

    }
```

```java
public class IdxMaximum {
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {
                biggest = index;
            }
            index = index + 1;
        }
        return biggest;
    }
}
```

```java
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
```

```java
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IdxFirstElemWithDuplicate {
    //@ requires arr != null && arr.length > 0;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures (\result == -1) <==> (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i < j < arr.length; arr[i] != arr[j]);
    //@ ensures 0 <= \result < arr.length ==> 
    //@          (\exists int k; \result < k < arr.length; arr[\result] == arr[k]) &&
    //@          (\forall int m; 0 <= m < \result; 
    //@              \forall int n; m < n < arr.length; arr[m] != arr[n]);
    //@ also
    //@ requires arr == null || arr.length == 0;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == -1;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    public static int idxFirstElemWithDuplicate(int[] arr) {

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= arr.length - 1;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int m; 0 <= m < i; 
        //@              \forall int n; m < n < arr.length; arr[m] != arr[n]);
        //@ loop_invariant i < arr.length;
        //@ loop_modifies i;
        //@ decreases arr.length - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length - 1; i++) {
            //@ maintaining i + 1 <= j && j <= arr.length;
            //@ maintaining (\forall int p; i + 1 <= p < j; arr[i] != arr[p]);
            //@ loop_invariant j <= arr.length;
            //@ loop_modifies j;
            //@ decreases arr.length - j;
            for (int j = i + 1; j < arr.length; j++) {
```

```java
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

    }
}
```

```java
public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
    //@  requires x.length != y.length;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ also
    //@  requires x != null && y != null;
    //@  requires x.length == y.length;

    //@  ensures \result == \forall int i; 0 <= i < x.length; x[i] == y[y.length - 1 - i];

            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
```

```java
public class MatrixSum {
    public static int[][] matrixSum(int[][] a, int[][] b) {
        int n = a.length;
        int m = a[0].length;

        int[][] c = new int[n][m];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                c[i][j] = a[i][j] + b[i][j];
            }
        }

        return c;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
    //@  requires \exists int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; arr[i] == elem;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures 0 <= \result < arr.length;
    //@  ensures \forall int i; 0 <= i < \result; arr[i] != elem;
    //@  ensures arr[\result] == elem;
    //@ also
    //@  requires arr == null || \forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; arr[i] != elem;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == -1;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    //@ pure
    public static int find(int[] arr, int elem) {
        if (arr == null)
            return -1;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= arr.length;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; arr[j] != elem;
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases arr.length - i;
```

```java
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
    //@  assigns \nothing;
```
```java
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));

    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

    }
```

```java
public class IdxMaximum {
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {
                biggest = index;
            }
            index = index + 1;
        }
        return biggest;
    }
}
```

```java
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
```

```java
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```java
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
        //@ maintaining \forall int k; i <= k < m; ret[k] == 0;
        //@ loop_writes ret[*], i;
```

```java
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
```

```java
      @ disjoint behaviors;
      @ complete behaviors;

    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {

        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;

        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 1 <= k < i; A[k] != null && A[k].length == n);

        //@ decreases m - i;
        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= m;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int x; 0 <= x < i; (\forall int y; 0 <= y < n; ret[x][y] == A[m - 1 - x][n - 1 - y]));

        //@ decreases m - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {

            //@ loop_writes ret[i][*], j;
            //@ decreases n - j;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
```

```java
public class IsStrictlyMonotonic {
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            if (nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }
        return inc || dec;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||

                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
```

Correction: The error is due to the use of the syntax `a[k .. iEnd - 1]` in the `loop_writes` clause, which is not accepted by the verifier. To fix this, replace the range expression with the correct JML syntax for array ranges in `loop_writes`, which uses `\subset` and `\old` or explicit quantification.

However, JML does not support `loop_writes` clauses with array slices directly. Instead, you should specify the set of locations that may be written to as a set of locations. The correct way is to use the `loop_writes` clause with a set of locations, for example:

```java
//@ loop_writes \subset(a, k, iEnd - 1);
```

But `\subset` is not standard JML. The standard way is to specify the set of locations explicitly:

```java
//@ loop_writes a[k], a[k+1], ..., a[iEnd-1];
```

But this is not feasible for variable ranges.

Alternatively, JML allows specifying the `loop_writes` clause as:

```java
//@ loop_writes a[k .. iEnd - 1];
```

But the verifier complains. So, the workaround is to specify that the `loop_writes` clause writes to the array `a` elements from `k` to `iEnd-1` through a quantified expression:

```java
//@ loop_writes (\forall int i; k <= i && i < iEnd; a[i]);
```

But this is not valid syntax.

Therefore, the accepted way is to specify the writes as:

```java
//@ loop_writes a[*];
```

which means the whole array `a` may be written.

Since the loop only writes to `a[k .. iEnd-1]`, but the verifier cannot handle the range, the best is to specify:

```java
//@ loop_writes a[*];
```

which is safe but less precise.

Hence, the corrected code is:

```java
    //@ requires 0 <= iBegin && iBegin <= iEnd && iEnd <= b.length && iEnd <= a.length;
    //@ assigns a[iBegin .. iEnd-1];
    //@ ensures \forall int i; iBegin <= i < iEnd; a[i] == b[i];
    //@ ensures \forall int i; (i < iBegin || i >= iEnd) ==> a[i] == \old(a[i]);
    //@ pure;
    public static void CopyArray(int[] b, int iBegin, int iEnd, int[] a) {

        //@ maintaining \forall int i; (i < iBegin || i >= k) ==> a[i] == \old(a[i]);
```

```java
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

The original source code is
```java
public class ClosedInterval {
    public static int[] closedInterval(int a, int b) {
        if (a > b) return null;

        int n = b - a + 1;
        int[] arr = new int[n];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            arr[i] = a + i;
        }

        return arr;
    }
}

```

```java
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
    //@  assigns \nothing;

    //@  assigns \nothing;
```
```java
    //@  ensures \result == false;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
```

```java
    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {
        int left1   = rec1[0];
        int bottom1 = rec1[1];
        int right1  = rec1[2];

        int top2    = rec2[3];

                 top2 <= bottom1 ||
                 left2 >= right1 ||
                 right2 <= left1);
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {

        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

    }
}
```

```java
public class ReverseArray {
    public static int[] reverse(int[] original) {
        int n = original.length;
        int[] res = new int[n];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            res[i] = original[n - i - 1];
        }
        return res;
    }
}

```

```java
public class ReverseArray {
    //@ requires original != null;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result != null;
    //@ ensures \result.length == original.length;
    //@ ensures \forall int i; 0 <= i < original.length; \result[i] == original[original.length - i - 1];
    public static int[] reverse(int[] original) {
        int n = original.length;
        int[] res = new int[n];

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; res[j] == original[n - j - 1];
        //@ maintaining \forall int k; i <= k < n; res[k] == 0;
        //@ loop_writes res[*], i;
```

```java
public class IsPalindrome {
    public static boolean isPalindrome(String s) {

        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            if (s.charAt(i) != s.charAt(n - 1 - i)) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```java
    //@ requires arr != null;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
```
```java
    //@ ensures \result == (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i < j < arr.length; arr[i] != arr[j]);
    //@ also

    public static boolean allUnique(int[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return true;
```

        //@ maintaining 0 < i < arr.length - 1;

        //@ loop_writes i;

        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length - 1; i++) {

```java
public class IdxMaximum {
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {
                biggest = index;
            }
            index = index + 1;
        }
        return biggest;
    }
}
```

```java
public class CompareArray {
    public static boolean arrcmp(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null) {
            return a == b;
        }
        if (a.length != b.length) {
            return false;
```

```java
    //@  requires \exists int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; arr[i] == elem;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures 0 <= \result < arr.length;
    //@  ensures \forall int i; 0 <= i < \result; arr[i] != elem;
    //@  ensures arr[\result] == elem;
    //@ also
    //@  requires arr == null || \forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; arr[i] != elem;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == -1;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    //@ pure
    public static int find(int[] arr, int elem) {
        if (arr == null)
            return -1;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= arr.length;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; arr[j] != elem;
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases arr.length - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++)
            if (arr[i] == elem)
                return i;
        return -1;
    }
}
```

```java
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

Correction explanation: The errors indicate that the verifier cannot find the symbol `ret` inside the `\old()` expression in the loop invariants. In JML, to refer to the old value of a variable, you must use `\old(variable)` but `ret` is a local variable, and `\old(ret[k])` is problematic because `ret` is an array and the verifier expects `\old` to refer to a variable or field, not an array element.

A common workaround is to capture the old array in a ghost variable or to avoid using `\old` on array elements directly. However, since we are not allowed to add any new variables or modify code other than specifications, the best fix is to remove the `\old` on `ret[k]` and just express the invariant in a way that does not require `\old`.

But since the problem only asks to fix the specifications, and the only errors are on the `\old(ret[k])` expressions, the simplest fix is to replace `\old(ret[k])` with `ret[k]` in the loop invariants, as the `ret` array is freshly allocated and not modified before the loop, so its elements are default zero.


```java

```

```java

```

to


because the array `ret` is newly allocated and thus all elements are initialized to zero by default.

**Refinement explanation:**

The errors indicate that `\old(ret[k])` and `\old(ret[l])` cannot find the symbol `ret` in the `\old` expression. This is because `ret` is a local variable declared inside the method, and JML's `\old` operator can only refer to variables visible at the method entry or fields of the class, not local variables declared after method entry.

To fix this, we need to capture the old value of `ret` before the loop starts. Since `ret` is freshly allocated right before the loops, its initial content is well-defined (all zeros in Java). However, JML does not assume array initialization values by default.

A common workaround is to use a ghost variable or to avoid referring to `\old(ret[k])` for local variables. Since the array `ret` is newly allocated and not modified before the first loop, we can replace `\old(ret[k])` with the known initial value (which is 0 for int arrays in Java). But since the specification is about maintaining unchanged parts of the array, and the array is freshly allocated, the initial content is zeros.

Alternatively, we can remove the `\old(ret[k])` clauses since the loops write to disjoint parts of `ret` and the other parts are untouched.

Hence, the best fix is to remove the problematic `\old(ret[k])` and `\old(ret[l])` clauses from the loop invariants:

```java
//@ maintaining 0 <= i <= m;
//@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; ret[j] == a[j];
//@ maintaining \forall int k; i <= k < m + n; true; // removed ret[k] == \old(ret[k])
```

and

```java
//@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
//@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; ret[j + m] == b[j];
//@ maintaining \forall int k; 0 <= k < m; ret[k] == a[k];
//@ maintaining \forall int l; i + m <= l < m + n; true; // removed ret[l] == \old(ret[l])
```

But since the user requested not to modify any content other than the specifications, the minimal fix is to remove the `\old(ret[k])` and `\old(ret[l])` parts from the loop invariants.

Hence, the corrected code is:

This is because `\old` refers to the pre-state of the method, and the variable `ret` does not exist before the method execution. To fix this, the `\old(ret[k])` should be replaced with a value that is well-defined in the pre-state or removed if not necessary.

However, since `ret` is a newly allocated array, its old value is not defined before the loop. So the invariant about `ret[k] == \old(ret[k])` for indices not yet written to is not meaningful.

```java
    //@  ensures \result == ((year % 4 == 0) && ((year % 100 != 0) || (year % 400 == 0)));
```

```java
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```java
            return false;

        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```java
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```java
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
    public static boolean IsStrictlyDecreasing(int[] arr) {

        if (n < 2) {
```

```java
public class IdxMaximum {
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {
                biggest = index;
            }
            index = index + 1;
        }
        return biggest;
    }
}
```

```java
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```java
public class TitleCase {
    //@ requires arr != null;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result != null && \result.length == arr.length;
    //@ ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; 
    //@            (Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ==> \result[i] == arr[i]) &&
    //@            (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) && 
    //@             (i == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1])) ==> \result[i] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[i])) &&
    //@            (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) && 
    //@             i > 0 && !Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1]) ==> \result[i] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[i])));
    //@ also
    //@ requires arr == null;
    //@ ensures \result == null;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining wordStart == (i == 0 || (i > 0 && Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1])));
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i;
        //@     (Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ==> ret[j] == arr[j]) &&
        //@     (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) && (j == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[j-1])) ==> ret[j] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[j])) &&
        //@     (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) && j > 0 && !Character.isWhitespace(arr[j-1]) ==> ret[j] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[j]));
        //@ loop_writes i, wordStart, ret[*];
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {

            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);

        }
```

Correction explanation:  
The error messages indicate that the verifier expects identifiers after the `behavior` keyword. The correct keyword is `behavior` (singular), not `behaviour` or `behavior` followed by a semicolon. However, the original code uses `behavior normal_case;` and `behavior empty_case;` which is syntactically correct in JML. The problem is that the JML parser expects the `behavior` keyword to be followed by a behavior identifier without a trailing semicolon. The correct syntax is:

```java
//@ behavior normal_case
//@ requires ...
//@ ensures ...
```

or if you want to declare behaviors separately, you can use:

```java
//@ behavior normal_case
//@ ...
//@ also
//@ behavior empty_case
//@ ...
```

But in the original code, the `behavior` lines are standalone with semicolons, which is not correct. They should be written without semicolons and immediately followed by the specification lines for that behavior.

Since the original code uses `also` to separate the two behaviors, the correct approach is to attach the `behavior` keyword to the respective specification parts.

Hence, the fix is to remove the semicolons after `behavior normal_case` and `behavior empty_case`, and place the `requires` and `ensures` clauses accordingly.

But the original code already uses `also` and the requires/ensures clauses are before the `behavior` keywords, which is not correct.

Therefore, to fix the problem, we should split the specification into two behavior blocks, each starting with `behavior <name>` and followed by the corresponding `requires`, `ensures`, and `assigns` clauses.

Here's the corrected specification:

```java
public class ClosedInterval {
    //@ behavior normal_case
    //@ requires a <= b && (long)b - (long)a + 1L <= Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    //@ ensures \result != null && \result.length == b - a + 1;
    //@ ensures \forall int i; 0 <= i < \result.length; \result[i] == a + i;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ also
    //@ behavior empty_case
    //@ requires a > b;
    //@ ensures \result == null;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ disjoint behaviors;
    //@ complete behaviors;
    public static int[] closedInterval(int a, int b) {
        if (a > b) return null;

        int n = b - a + 1;
        int[] arr = new int[n];

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; arr[j] == a + j;
        //@ maintaining \forall int k; i <= k < n; arr[k] == 0;
        //@ loop_writes arr[*], i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            arr[i] = a + i;
        }

        return arr;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
```

```java
        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
```

```java
public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
    //@     (\forall int i; 0 <= i < nums.length - 1; nums[i] > nums[i + 1])
    //@ );
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;
```

        //@ maintaining 0 - 1 <= i - 1 <= n - 1;  
        //@ maintaining inc == (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i; nums[j] < nums[j + 1]);
        //@ maintaining dec == (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i; nums[j] > nums[j + 1]);
        //@ loop_writes i, inc, dec;
        //@ decreases n - 1 - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            if (nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }
        return inc || dec;
    }

```java
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IdxMaximum {
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {
                biggest = index;
            }
            index = index + 1;
        }
        return biggest;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IdxMaximum {
    //@ requires a != null;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures (a.length == 0 ==> \result == -1) &&
    //@         (a.length > 0 ==> (0 <= \result < a.length &&
    //@         (\forall int i; 0 <= i < a.length; a[i] <= a[\result])));
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {

            return -1;

        int index = 0;
```

```java
public class CompareArray {
    public static boolean arrcmp(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null) {
            return a == b;
        }
        if (a.length != b.length) {
            return false;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
            if (a[i] != b[i]) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
    //@ pure
```

```java
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```java
    //@ requires a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == null;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= m;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i; ret[j] == a[j]);
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; i <= k < m + n; ret[k] == 0);
        //@ loop_writes ret[*], i;
        //@ decreases m - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i; ret[j + m] == b[j]);
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k < m; ret[k] == a[k]);
        //@ maintaining (\forall int l; i + m <= l < m + n; ret[l] == 0);
        //@ loop_writes ret[*], i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
```

```java
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {

            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;

                wordStart = false;
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```java
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IdxMaximum {
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {
                biggest = index;
            }
            index = index + 1;
        }
        return biggest;
    }
}
```

```java
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```java
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```java
public class CompareArray {
    public static boolean arrcmp(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null) {
            return a == b;
        }
        if (a.length != b.length) {
            return false;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
            if (a[i] != b[i]) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class ReverseArray {
    public static int[] reverse(int[] original) {
        int n = original.length;
        int[] res = new int[n];

            res[i] = original[n - i - 1];
```

Wait, the above added a requires clause that refers to sum, which is a local variable, so that is not valid as a precondition.

We cannot refer to local variables in requires clauses.

We need to ensure that in the loop, sum - 1 does not underflow.

Since sum starts at x, and in the else branch y <= 0, and n = -y > 0, sum is decremented n times.

So sum goes from x down to x - n.

We must ensure that sum >= Integer.MIN_VALUE + 1 before the subtraction.

But since sum changes in the loop, we must specify loop invariants to ensure sum - 1 does not underflow.

We can add loop invariants in the else branch:

- sum > Integer.MIN_VALUE

Because sum = x - ((-y) - n), and (-y) - n >= 0, so sum >= x - (-y)

But we have the precondition Integer.MIN_VALUE + y <= x, which means x - (-y) >= Integer.MIN_VALUE.

So sum >= Integer.MIN_VALUE.

But sum - 1 may underflow if sum == Integer.MIN_VALUE.

So to prevent that, sum must be > Integer.MIN_VALUE before subtracting 1.

We can add a loop invariant:

//@ maintaining sum > Integer.MIN_VALUE;

Similarly, in the if branch, sum + 1 must not overflow, so add:

//@ maintaining sum < Integer.MAX_VALUE;

But the precondition Integer.MIN_VALUE + y <= x && x <= Integer.MAX_VALUE - y ensures that.

So let's add these loop invariants.

Final code:

```java
public class Add {
    //@ requires y != Integer.MIN_VALUE;
    //@ requires Integer.MIN_VALUE + y <= x && x <= Integer.MAX_VALUE - y;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == x + y;
    public static int add(int x, int y) {
        int sum = x;
        if (y > 0) {
            int n = y;
            //@ maintaining 0 <= n && n <= y;
            //@ maintaining sum == x + (y - n);
            //@ maintaining sum < Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            //@ loop_writes sum, n;
            //@ decreases n;
            while (n > 0) {
                sum = sum + 1;
                n = n - 1;
            }
        } else {
            int n = -y;
            //@ maintaining 0 <= n && n <= -y;
            //@ maintaining sum == x - ((-y) - n);
            //@ maintaining sum > Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            //@ loop_writes sum, n;
            //@ decreases n;
            while (n > 0) {
                sum = sum - 1;
                n = n - 1;
            }
        }
        return sum;
    }
}
```

This should allow the verifier to prove no underflow/overflow occurs during sum + 1 or sum - 1.

```java
    public static int find(int[] arr, int elem) {
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```
